mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph drainage network to the body was most worthwhile: the planned before-and-after views connect continuous fluid movement to preventing accumulation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive collecting-vessel and venous-junction connections were clear but predictable, so they offered little decision-making once the route was visible.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting previously built systems and tracing fluid return gave the constructions a useful physiological purpose, even if some steps were predictable.
